independence: Independent auditor (role reviewer, sub-lane avatar-i18n-auditor of session 44ad14bfaf17); did not write or edit the translations; translator was coder. No fallback model was used.

reference.source: origin/main of damianvtran/local-operator at audit time

method: Read the 6 new values per locale against English, the English context sidecar, the core glossary, the locale style guide and sibling keys in the same namespaces; mechanically checked placeholders ({name}), key parity/order, untranslated values and absence of bidi control characters (U+200E/F, U+061C, U+202A-E, U+2066-9). No rendered-fit or native-reader claim.

findings.finding: "Qué tan grande se ve" is Latin-American-marked; es style guide requires wording that reads the same in Madrid and Mexico City. The sibling ui.agents.avatar.editor.preview_header also says "cabecera", this value says "encabezado".
findings.suggested_fix: Tamaño de la foto del agente en la ventana de chat y en su cabecera. La barra lateral mantiene su tamaño.
